thread:
sophie: Morning — quick preflight for the release train. Cut window in ~3h. High-level: main branch green, cherry queue has 4 PRs, one security backport pending. Any urgent blockers?
release-bot: CI status: main ✅, infra-tests ⚠️ (2 failures), canary deployment in staging: healthy.
jordan: I merged the perf fix cherry (PR #4321) into the cut branch — small change, retested locally.
kevin: heads-up: trying to apply the security backport, hitting merge conflict with the allocator-rewrite. Needs a manual resolution.
maria: @kevin I can pair on the conflict now — give me the branch name and I’ll take a look.
kevin: branch is `backport/sec-2026` — conflict in `gpu_scheduler.cc` around the new API.
jenkins-bot: (automated) re-run job #1254 for PR 4321 queued.
alex: also flagging that the canary p99 latency spiked after the nightly kernel update — Lina did a quick check, might be related to kernel preemption settings.
lina: verified spike on canary at 03:12 UTC — p50 stable, but p99 jumped ~80ms. I rolled canary back to previous host image; monitoring now.
ci-bot: failing job details: https://ci.internal/1254 — test `alloc-integrity` failed on runner-4 with OOM. Log snippet: ```OOM in shard 3 at 0x7ff...
Backtrace: allocation_try -> allocate_buffer -> oom_check```
kevin: that OOM is the reason the backport conflict surfaced (flaky test exposed merged state). I’ll repro locally and open a hotfix PR if needed.
sophie: plan: hold public cut until security backport is clean and runner-4 flakiness understood. If we can fix/rebase in <90m we still cut on schedule; otherwise we move cut window +2h.
jordan: quick request — can reviewers prioritize the three non-security cherries? Two are small docs/telemetry changes, one is a config tweak that reduces batch size (helps p99).
maria: taking the two docs/telemetry reviews now. @alex can you glance at the config tweak?
alex: will review in 15m, but if it's a perf safety change pls add `needs-perf-approval`.
kevin: repro started. If I can’t get a clean backport within 45m I’ll propose a partial revert of the allocator-rewrite on the cut branch to unblock.
sophie: agree — escalate revert if necessary. Also tagging @eng-sre to watch runner-4.
release-bot: Rollout note: canary reverted to image v2026.03.11 (pre-kernel-update). Observability will report after 5m.
lina: monitoring shows p99 back to baseline after revert :white_check_mark:.
jordan: once kevin confirms backport or revert, I’ll queue the final smoke deploy and ping infra for an extended rollout window.
ci-bot: re-run complete: PR 4321 pipeline passed on re-run ✅
kevin: local repro shows same OOM if we run 50 concurrent allocations. Trying a mitigation: bump arena back-pressure threshold. Pushing WIP patch to `kevin/backport-fix` in 10m.
sophie: thanks. If the patch lands and CI is green, we proceed with cut. If not, shift +2h. Please post status updates here every 20m.
jordan: noted. pinging reviewers and tagging `@oncall-release` for visibility. :bell:
